_comment: The hierarchy the deploy script converges the chain to. Declarative and idempotent: run it
again and it registers only what is missing.
BROKERS are infrastructure — each gets its own UserRegistry proxy, a name under the parent,
and setParent wired back. Add one here and re-run buildHierarchy().
INVESTORS listed here are BOOTSTRAP ONLY. In the real flow they arrive via an application ->
CRE verdict -> MintAttestor -> SubnameRegistrar (beats 1-3). Keep this list to the few needed
before CRE exists, and to the two the demo needs guaranteed present. Adding everyone here
wallet: leave empty to derive a deterministic placeholder. Placeholders CANNOT SIGN, so any
investor who has to transact on camera needs a real address here. Every investor must have a
distinct wallet — the checker stores one leaf per account.
ttl: seconds until the broker's name expires. 0 means take the BROKER_TTL env default, which
is what the demo shortens to film the lapse. Give brokers that must SURVIVE the lapse an
explicit long ttl — otherwise a global short TTL expires all of them at once and the cascade
looks like a kill switch rather than something scoped to one broker.
